berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.description: Can't take the Cast Action or Focus, it can’t be Frightened, and it doesn’t make Morale Checks.

burning.name: Burning
burning.description: A die roll indicates damage it takes at the start of its turns, unless an appropriate action is taken to end it (such as dousing fire).

charmed.name: Charmed
charmed.description: It can't willingly attack the charmer.

confused.name: Confused
confused.description: Its Checks and SAves have Hinder, and Saves against its Actions have Favor.

dazed.name: Dazed
dazed.description: It can't Focus or Move unless it uses an Action to do so.

fatigued.name: Fatigued
fatigued.description: Fatigue is measured from 0 to 5 with the following rules: - Each Fatigue occupies an Item Slot. - At 3 or ore Fatigue, it can't Rush. - At 5 Fatigue, it dies.

frightened.name: Frightened
frightened.description: It has a -2 penalty to damage it deals.

grappling.name: Grappling
grappling.description: Physically causing a Target to be Restrained by using your body is Grappling. A Being that is physically restraining a Target has its Speed halved, unless the Target is smaller.

incapacitated.name: Incapacitated
incapacitated.description: It can't Focus or use its Actions or Move, fails all Might and Dexterity Checks, and is Vulnerable.

invisible.name: Invisible
invisible.description: It can't be seen by normal senses, and thos that can't see it act as Blinded for Checks and Saves involving it.

paralyzed.name: Paralyzed
paralyzed.description: It is Incapacitated and its Speed is 0.

prone.name: Prone
prone.description: You can either drop or stand from Prone by using 10' of Speed. While Prone: Speed cost is halved, it cannot Rush, and is Vulnerable for the purposes of Melee Attacks and Dodge Checks.

restrained.name: Restrained
restrained.description: It is Vulnerable and its Speed is 0.

sickened.name: Sickened
sickened.description: It has a -2 penalty to any healing it receives. Additional effects may be indicated by the cause of the Sickness.

suffocating.name: Suffocating
suffocating.description: Beings begin Suffocating after not breathing for 1 Minute. Heroes: Each Round, while Suffocating, roll a d8. If the result is equal to or greater than your Might, gain 1 Fatigue. Enemies: Each Round, while Suffocating, gain 1 Fatigue.

unconscious.name: Unconscious
unconscious.description: It is Blinded, Incapacitated, and Prone. Close Attacks Targeting it always Crit.

vulnerable.name: Vulnerable
vulnerable.description: Its attacks and Saves against attacks have Hinder. Attacks targeting it and Saves against its attacks have Favor.
